senses.gloss: hide prepared for writing (contrad. to מצה a. חיפה, v. also דוכסוסטוס).
units: Ib. 19ᵃ defined די׳ דמליח וכ׳ diphtera is a skin prepared with salt and flour, but not with gallnut, v. אֲפַץ; Sabb. 79ᵃ; Gitt. 22ᵃ

senses.gloss: record, document, list. Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 ד׳ של אלוהות a list of the deities; Yalk. Ex. 175.—Pl. דִּיפְתְּרָאוֹת, דִּיפְתְּרִין, דִּפְ׳.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:4:6">Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דִּפְתְּרֵיהֶן</he> their (national) records.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 8:1">Pesik. R. s. 8</cite> <he>ד׳ כתובות וכ׳</he> records are written before the Lord &c.
